Hi Olivia,

Thanks for taking this on — happy to get you a compact preflight bundle that speeds your SOC 2 Type II review. To make this low-friction for your auditors, we prioritize a short, representative set of artifacts first and then provide the full report and support as needed.

Priority ask (what we'd like to send first):
- Final SOC 2 Type II report (if available) or Type II bridge letter draft (attached).
- Three representative log extracts covering: API request logs, auth/SSO events, and system-ops alerts (see sample manifest attached).
- Control narrative summary (1–2 pages) describing change management, access control, and incident response.
- Policy snapshots: Acceptable Use + Data Retention + Backup & Recovery (PDFs or Drive links).

Prefered delivery options: presigned S3 URLs, secure Drive folder link, or SFTP. We can also redact PII before sending if you prefer.

One-line reply templates (feel free to copy):
- "Received — please share presigned S3 link and we will upload the three sample logs and the bridge letter by EOD."
- "Can you confirm the audit period you need covered so we send the correct log slices?"

Attachments: redwood_soc2_bridge_letter_20261027.pdf (draft), sample-logs-manifest.csv, evidence-sampler-instructions.md

Planned next step: once you confirm audit period and preferred transfer method, we’ll stage the artifacts and share a presigned link.

Thanks,

Hi Olivia — answering inline:
1) Audit period we are proposing: 2025-10-01 through 2026-03-31 (six-month period). If you need a different window, tell us and we’ll re-slice the logs.
2) Suggested sample windows: three non-overlapping 24-hour slices (we recommend one weekday business day, one weekend day, and one high-traffic day). Each slice should include full request headers, timestamps, user IDs (hashed), and outcome codes. The attached sample manifest has exact column expectations.
3) We’ll provide presigned S3 links. Naming convention: redwood_acme/{artifact_type}/{YYYYMMDD}_{slice}_{redacted}.zip. We prefer gzip-compressed CSVs.

Attached: redwood_soc2_bridge_letter_20261027.pdf (draft), evidence-sampler-instructions.md, sample-logs-manifest.csv.

Internal note: @priyom, can you and @karthik confirm availability to run the extracts tomorrow AM and produce the three 24-hour slices? Also confirm whether we need to mask any internal user IDs beyond SHA256 hashing.

- "Attached: bridge letter + three representative log slices. We will follow up with full report access on request."
- "We can provide redacted snapshots; please confirm fields to redact and we will prepare a second copy."

Thanks — I’ll prepare the presigned links after Prio/Batch confirm extraction timeline.
